summary: End-to-end validation of the 1099-NEC / W-9 module (Ross House backend :8002 + Next.js :3001). 14/14 pytest tests passed covering summary, PDF, threshold auto-alert + auto W-9 request, public W-9 GET/POST (valid + invalid TIN + invalid token), reminder cycle (send #2 + escalation + no re-escalation), Copy B config toggle, Copy B batch (sent + already_sent on re-run), deadline reminder, manual request-w9, and admin auth check. Frontend UI: public /w9/[token] mobile form loads (contractor name shown, ES/EN toggle works), all fields fill, certification checkbox and signature work, submit → ¡Listo! thanks screen; provider W-9 persisted in Mongo (TIN 555-44-3333). Admin panel /admin/formularios-1099 renders correctly with cookies rhr_admin_token + rhr_admin_user, QA row visible with $650, Copy B auto/manual toggle is clickable + toggles state (verified visual change + toast '✅ Envío automático activado'), 'Enviar Copy B ahora' button present (not clicked to avoid mass send), W-9 edit + PDF + Enviar buttons visible per row. 'Pedir W-9' button correctly hidden after the W-9 was completed via public form (expected behavior). All 4 QA providers + payments cleaned from Mongo at the end. copyb config restored to auto=true.

issues: Ciudad/Estado/Código postal inputs have no data-testid (only address, legal_name, tin, certify, signature, submit do). Not blocking but makes future testing harder — consider adding w9-city, w9-state, w9-zip.

Optional: add data-testid to the W-9 edit button and modal in /app/app/admin/formularios-1099/page.tsx (only the copyb-* and request-w9-* buttons currently have testIDs).
critical_code_review_comments: tax_1099_router.py: send_w9_request() gates on W9_RESEND_DAYS (14d) via cooldown; manual /admin/1099/providers/{id}/request-w9 correctly $unsets w9_request.sent_at before calling — good pattern.

check_1099_threshold() is fired as asyncio.create_task from POST /admin/service-providers/{id}/payments (fire-and-forget) — tests accounted for the async delay with a 5s sleep and it consistently sets tax_1099_alerts + w9_request.token.
public_w9_submit validates TIN length (9 digits) and returns 422 on invalid — verified.
w9_reminder_sweep correctly increments sends, and idempotent on escalation (w9_request.escalated_at prevents second escalation) — verified with two consecutive runs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public W-9 form + admin panel core UI verified)
